help: compute with integers (fixed point for a fraction), and move floats only as bits
diagnostics.message: `warm` is `@deterministic`, and float arithmetic (`Add`) isn't the same on every GPU
notes: a deterministic kernel computes with integers, and moves floats only as bits: its result is then the same on every GPU and on the CPU (§18.14)
diagnostics.title: a `@deterministic` kernel that does something a GPU may do its own way
